name: context-compass
description: Map project context, code hygiene, docs, memory surfaces, and next best actions before Codex changes a repository.

interface.shortDescription: Map context and choose a grounded next step.
interface.longDescription: Context Compass helps Codex orient before acting. It scans local project instructions, docs, plugin metadata, code/test hygiene, recent git signals, and optional portfolio knowledge-base files, then returns an evidence-backed context map with ranked next best actions.
defaultPrompt: Map this repo's context before we act.
Find context risks and next best actions.
Show code, docs, tests, and memory signals.
